scoring_justification: The tight-binding Hamiltonian simulation is too expensive to rerun in the checker; we verify the agent's computed Δ5-1 and localization fractions against the paper's reported values with tolerances and threshold checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported Δ5-1 values and confinement thresholds for t=7.8 nm and t=12.2 nm
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: J. Phys.: Conf. Ser. 100 052049, Figure 2/3 and text; Δ_{5-1}=5.3 meV for t=7.8 nm, 3.7 meV for t=12.2 nm. Localization thresholds 0.8/0.2 set from observed separation between confined and extended states.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper's reported numbers and typical confinement criteria.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are reported in the paper and are the basis for verification.

outputs.description: Computed eigenvalues and charge-density localization fractions for the first and fifth conduction-band states at two interconnect thicknesses. The checker will compare eigenvalues (from which Δ5-1 is derived) and localization fractions to hidden reference values with tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The target policy is exact_match because the scored quantities are deterministic outputs of the tight-binding simulation; the checker will accept results within specified absolute tolerances. Localization fraction thresholds are verified as part of the same comparison.

steps.description: For t=7.8 nm, check Δ5-1 (eV) within tolerance and localization fraction of 5th eigenstate ≥ threshold
For t=12.2 nm, check Δ5-1 (eV) within tolerance and localization fraction of 5th eigenstate ≤ threshold
